page_note: Page exhibits three-part structure: (1) cosmic substrate mapping the second ploughed-field=living soul with two great Luminaries as farmers in the heavens; (2) editorial seam — 'third land is the holy Church' extends the agricultural pattern to the institutional church (elect/catechumens), even while reusing genuine substrate diction (Mind of Light); (3) hortatory application calling the audience to 'become beautiful farmers'. Classic three-layer composition. Substrate is preserved only in the second-field section.
